title: 加速器束流位置監測
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
summary: 以 3 GeV 儲存環的四鈕扣束流位置監測器為對象，從相對論束團的鏡像電流與電極轉移阻抗出發，推導差和比靈敏度與熱雜訊解析度，再處理增益失衡、束流基準對準、快速軌道回授與交接文件。
summaryEn: Taking the four-button beam-position monitor of a 3 GeV storage ring, start from the image current of a relativistic bunch and the pickup transfer impedance, derive difference-over-sum sensitivity and thermal-noise resolution, then handle gain imbalance, beam-based alignment, fast orbit feedback and handoff documentation.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」與「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch" and "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bunch field and wall image current” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。管壁上的任何電極只要截取一部分鏡像電流，就得到與束團縱向分佈相同時間形狀的訊號；因此位置監測器量的不是束團本身，而是鏡像電荷在圓周上的分佈。束團長度決定訊號頻寬，電極與電子學則在某個射頻諧波上處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current. Any electrode in the wall that intercepts part of this image current produces a signal with the same time shape as the longitudinal bunch profile, so a position monitor measures the azimuthal distribution of image charge rather than the bunch itself. Bunch length sets the signal bandwidth, and the pickup and electronics process one RF harmonic of it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bunch field and wall image current”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bunch field and wall image current”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch

Any electrode in the wall that intercepts part of this image current produces a signal with the same time shape as the longitudinal bunch profile, so a position monitor measures the azimuthal distribution of image charge rather than the bunch itself.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「加速器束流位置監測」的「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: mechanism and system boundary” in “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch" is correct?
options: 鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。
電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。
差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。
optionsEn: A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly.

An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current.
Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading.
quiz.explanation: 電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bunch field and wall image current” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。束團 σ_z = 10 mm 對應 σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps，高斯頻譜在 f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz 處降到 e^(−1/2)；在 500 MHz 的處理頻率上 ωσ_t ≈ 0.10，形狀因子 exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995，幾乎不衰減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch. A bunch with σ_z = 10 mm has σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps, and its Gaussian spectrum falls to e^(−1/2) near f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz; at the 500 MHz processing frequency ωσ_t ≈ 0.10 and the form factor exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995 is nearly unity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。束團 σ_z = 10 mm 對應 σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps，高斯頻譜在 f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz 處降到 e^(−1/2)；在 500 MHz 的處理頻率上 ωσ_t ≈ 0.10，形狀因子 exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995，幾乎不衰減。
knowledge.textEn: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch. A bunch with σ_z = 10 mm has σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps, and its Gaussian spectrum falls to e^(−1/2) near f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz; at the 500 MHz processing frequency ωσ_t ≈ 0.10 and the form factor exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995 is nearly unity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch", which statement holds?
options: 只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。
解析度與頻寬無關，一個 BPM 只有一個解析度數字。
3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。
optionsEn: If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre.
Resolution is independent of bandwidth, so a BPM has a single resolution figure.

A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch.
quiz.explanation: 3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bunch field and wall image current” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。
knowledge.textEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch"?
options: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。
optionsEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise.
quiz.explanation: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bunch field and wall image current” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束團長度決定訊號頻寬，電極與電子學則在某個射頻諧波上處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bunch length sets the signal bandwidth, and the pickup and electronics process one RF harmonic of it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
knowledge.textEn: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity.
Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading.
quiz.explanation: 把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四鈕扣差和比」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Four-button difference-over-sum” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓管內束流偏離中心 x 時，壁面鏡像電荷密度對角度 θ 的分佈為 (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ))，小位移時近似 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ。四個鈕扣放在 ±45° 與 ±135°，把對角兩組的和相減再除以四者總和，得到與 x 成正比而與束流電流無關的差和比；y 方向同理。靈敏度由管半徑與電極位置決定，非線性項隨 (r/R)³ 增長，所以大位移需要用邊界元素計算或實驗室校正表修正。解析度則由各電極訊號的訊雜比與處理頻寬決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四鈕扣差和比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the beam is displaced by x inside a round pipe, the wall image-charge density versus angle θ is (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ)), approximately 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ for small displacement. Four buttons at ±45° and ±135° give, by subtracting the two diagonal pair sums and dividing by the total, a difference-over-sum ratio proportional to x and independent of beam current; y follows the same logic. Sensitivity is set by pipe radius and electrode positions, and the nonlinear terms grow as (r/R)³, so large displacements need boundary-element calculations or a laboratory calibration map. Resolution is set by the signal-to-noise ratio of each electrode and the processing bandwidth. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four-button difference-over-sum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四鈕扣差和比」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Four-button difference-over-sum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Four buttons at ±45° and ±135° give, by subtracting the two diagonal pair sums and dividing by the total, a difference-over-sum ratio proportional to x and independent of beam current; y follows the same logic.

quiz.question: 關於「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution" is correct?

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四鈕扣差和比」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Four-button difference-over-sum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。R = 20 mm 時 k_x = 14.1 mm，x = 100 µm 給出 Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³。若每個電極在 1 MHz 頻寬內的訊號功率為 −20 dBm，熱雜訊 kTB = −114 dBm 加 3 dB 雜訊指數為 −111 dBm，功率訊雜比 91 dB，振幅相對雜訊 σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵；四電極的 σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵，位置解析度 σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2. For R = 20 mm, k_x = 14.1 mm and x = 100 µm gives Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³. If each electrode delivers −20 dBm in a 1 MHz bandwidth while thermal noise kTB = −114 dBm plus a 3 dB noise figure is −111 dBm, the power SNR is 91 dB, the relative amplitude noise is σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵, four electrodes give σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵, and the position resolution is σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。R = 20 mm 時 k_x = 14.1 mm，x = 100 µm 給出 Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³。若每個電極在 1 MHz 頻寬內的訊號功率為 −20 dBm，熱雜訊 kTB = −114 dBm 加 3 dB 雜訊指數為 −111 dBm，功率訊雜比 91 dB，振幅相對雜訊 σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵；四電極的 σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵，位置解析度 σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm。
knowledge.textEn: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2. For R = 20 mm, k_x = 14.1 mm and x = 100 µm gives Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³. If each electrode delivers −20 dBm in a 1 MHz bandwidth while thermal noise kTB = −114 dBm plus a 3 dB noise figure is −111 dBm, the power SNR is 91 dB, the relative amplitude noise is σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵, four electrodes give σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵, and the position resolution is σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution", which statement holds?
options: BPM 的零點就是真空管的幾何中心，不需要束流校正。
回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。
optionsEn: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2.
A BPM's zero is the geometric centre of the vacuum chamber and needs no beam-based calibration.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise.
quiz.explanation: 45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四鈕扣差和比」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Four-button difference-over-sum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using the linear formula at 5 mm off-axis lets the cubic term underestimate the reading by about 10%, so orbit correction converges to the wrong orbit; the quadrupolar beam-size term also leaks into the position reading at large offsets.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。
knowledge.textEn: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項。
BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term.
A BPM's calibration constants, once measured, stay valid forever.
quiz.explanation: 在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「四鈕扣差和比」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Four-button difference-over-sum” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using the linear formula at 5 mm off-axis lets the cubic term underestimate the reading by about 10%, so orbit correction converges to the wrong orbit; the quadrupolar beam-size term also leaks into the position reading at large offsets. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解析度則由各電極訊號的訊雜比與處理頻寬決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Resolution is set by the signal-to-noise ratio of each electrode and the processing bandwidth.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。
knowledge.textEn: Using the linear formula at 5 mm off-axis lets the cubic term underestimate the reading by about 10%, so orbit correction converges to the wrong orbit; the quadrupolar beam-size term also leaks into the position reading at large offsets.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差和比靈敏度與位置解析度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
鈕扣做得越大，訊號越強，所以位置量測一定越準。
在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A larger button gives more signal and therefore always better position accuracy.
Using the linear formula at 5 mm off-axis lets the cubic term underestimate the reading by about 10%, so orbit correction converges to the wrong orbit.
quiz.explanation: 在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the linear formula at 5 mm off-axis lets the cubic term underestimate the reading by about 10%, so orbit correction converges to the wrong orbit; the quadrupolar beam-size term also leaks into the position reading at large offsets. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
